title: Member Leads » Edit Leads
text:
## Member Leads » Edit Leads
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000069107
By default all sites come a two ways for the visitors and members to submit a lead - The Get Matched page/form and the Profile Contact forms.
During this process the form submitter may accidentally select the wrong Sub Category or make a typo while filling out their information. At which point they may reach out to the site Admin through the Contact Us form about this error - with this functionality it is possible to go in and edit the lead information.

## How to Edit a Lead
1) Go to Leads » Manage Leads
In this example, the visitor selected "6:00 AM" instead of "4:00 AM".
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127284061/original/4KJBQPZgnUm7kNmYw2xpVAtrEK3HOb0Tqw.png?1687409768 | alt: ]
2) Inside the Actions drop-down, select " Edit Lead ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127284077/original/3Ikm2NS_DBqwIRrFyYPbbE_akhmJrJZt7w.png?1687409788 | alt: ]
3 ) This will open a popup with the Lead Form, now it is possible to change the information that was incorrectly submitted:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127284126/original/6edwIIa4KUZ2e5rGyXsJxbtbGXRmDVDwFQ.png?1687409932 | alt: ]
The changes are immediately reflected:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127284135/original/-jCB638fiIS5vm7vLyFW-SpEK5pJQV2FxA.png?1687409987 | alt: ]
